correctness.rationale: For each cubic circular ladder C_n□K2 and twisted Möbius ladder (n>=3), every rich edge has four distinct adjacent edge colors and its own fifth color, forcing chi_rn>=5. In the proposed cyclic edge-colour assignment two rim edges at column i receive a_i and the rung c_i; the all-distinct triple {a_(i-1),a_i,c_i} enforces properness and distinct quadruple {a_(i-1),a_(i+1),c_i,c_(i+1)} makes every horizontal edge rich, including either seam closure. Four stated cyclic state blocks of length 5,6,8,9 share starting state (0,1,3) so concatenate without invalid joins. Lengths 5,6 and n>=8 follow from blocks 8..12 plus multiples of 5; n=3,4,7 use six explicit incidence-checked tables. All edges touch a rich rim edge. Independently reconstructed graph incidence for the six exceptions and four blocks with both twists (14 instances) and confirmed proper and rich-neighbor conditions. Infinite n follows from transition and decomposition, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: All graphs finite, undirected, simple and n>=3, rich is defined using the OPEN edge neighbourhood, not strong colouring.
The finite incidence checker alone cannot prove the infinite family; common-state concatenation is essential.
